# reflex-cu

> Open-source computer use MCP server for Claude Code, Codex and other AI agents. It controls macOS and Windows desktops, and a remote Windows machine over SSH, by reading the accessibility / UI Automation tree instead of taking a screenshot at every step. Jev (TypeSafe's System One decision model) answers the small decisions between steps: which element, did it work, has it loaded. MIT licensed, Python 3.10+.

Tools: status, screenshot, windows, focus, observe, click, move, drag, scroll, key, type, find, check, wait, steps. The three Jev tools (find, check, wait) need the user's own key from TypeSafe, OpenRouter or Command Code; everything else works without one.

## Install in one sentence

Tell your coding agent: "Install reflex-cu for me, following https://github.com/8itlab/reflex-cu/blob/main/INSTALL_FOR_AI.en.md"
